name: docs-templates
body:
Template-author reference (docs/templates.md): a repo `docs/templates.md` is the template-author reference — the library layout (`library.yaml`, `slides/<name>/`, `sections/<name>/`, `themes/<name>/`, `media/`, and the inert non-library root entries), the `template.yaml` manifest fields (every field type and key: `description`, `fields` with type/required/default/limits/variants/formats/description, `sections` with accepted/min/max, and the `body` rule including its `tables` option — its sub-keys `min_tables`, `max_tables`, `min_columns`, `max_columns`, `min_rows`, `max_rows` and its `cell_attributes` declarations, with the `{br}` line break and the `{…}` cell-attribute groups), the reserved `.deck`/`.slide`/`.item`/`.raw`/`.data`/`.table`/`.tables` context and the reserved names `deck`/`slide`/`item`/`raw`/`data`/`table`/`tables`, the `media`/`section`/`dict`/`list`/`child`/`children` helper set, the `{{ template "<layout name>" . }}` layout composition and the layer-relative layout-name form (`slides/<template-name>/layout.html.tmpl` for a slide layout and `sections/<template-name>/layout.html.tmpl` for a section layout), and the theme and media reference rules (theme-owned files, token-only themes, and the reserved `media:` and `theme:<name>/` URL prefixes). It documents the format the code implements and is not a template asset. README.md links to it.

AC: docs/templates.md exists and is linked from README.md; it documents the library layout, every `template.yaml` field type and key (including the `body.tables` option, its sub-keys and `cell_attributes`), the reserved context and names, the helper set, the `{{ template }}` layout composition and the layer-relative layout-name form, and the theme/media reference rules, consistently with templates-dir-layout, template-manifest, field-types, template-context, template-language, theme-media-references, template-media, portable-layout-names and example-layout-composition.
